correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 and fixed weight three, zero-before-one coordinates are a bijection. Direct scattered-count identities reduce the full profile to (S,Q,T). With S,T fixed, the equality of Q is a quadratic in the first coordinate, so each fiber has at most two elements. The second root reverses the two internal zero gaps, with integrality, order and endpoint constraints explicitly derived; unique orientation gives the claimed parametrization. Counting a, u, t produces the exact sum, rational generating function and 1/4 limiting ambiguous-word fraction. A separate complete subsequence DP confirmed all fibers for 3<=n<=30 and independent coefficient identities through n=1000. Infinite conclusions use algebra, not extrapolated tests.

value.rationale: A low-length scattered-subsequence deck is a natural reconstruction observation; Hamming weight three is the first binary sparse layer permitting nontrivial collisions. Exact ambiguity at every length, a sharp two-to-one fiber law, complete gap-reflection parametrization, and an asymptotically nonzero one-quarter ambiguous-word fraction describe a meaningful structural boundary. The result is not a mere finite census or change of notation and makes no unproved higher-weight claims.
